direct_call_candidates.scope: Raw encoded-reference scan, not proof excluding computed/indirect calls or data coincidences

static_anchors.ex_mask: u16 profile+0x216; mask table entries u32

status: accepted_after_document_corrections; no implementation approval or modified-ROM test

corrections.issue: EX mission read described as byte[EC30+i], EX ownership described as u32
corrections.correct: Both consumers read u16[0x0202EC30] at a fixed address; table mission IDs are u8. Ownership at profile+0x216 is loaded/stored as u16; only mask table entries are u32.

corrections.issue: P1 return-zero claimed to guarantee ELF=15
corrections.correct: 0x0801CEF0 adds helper return to existing u32[EBF0+0x10]. Returning zero only suppresses this contribution; no universal zero total is proved.

corrections.issue: P1 closing switch claimed to restore original history/results
corrections.correct: Queue writes can be retained, but already accumulated score, grade and awarded EX are not automatically recomputed or revoked. Call wraps queue[283] as u8.

corrections.issue: Conditional 2-byte switch and bx lr pseudocode unsafe
corrections.correct: Only unconditional return-zero can fit the original 0x080D61DA halfword (201c -> 0020). A runtime switch needs checked storage and a real hook/trampoline preserving r4/r5 and the original pop/pop/bx epilogue. No unused RAM bit is established.

corrections.issue: Enemy division-zero/branch omitted, byte sum called signed loads
corrections.correct: q=0 gives 0 without division; n>24 gives 0. Actual six loads are unsigned, sum truncated to u8, then total sign-extended to s8 and accumulated/read as s16.

corrections.issue: EX effect described as changing current reward through recalculated grade
corrections.correct: The qualification bit is set before score recalculation using the incoming grade; later grade changes do not retroactively rerun that gate.

corrections.issue: Call count cap and codename grade terminology
corrections.correct: D6138 increments at old count<=98, hence can reach99; record+2 is codename index, not rank at record+1.

corrections.issue: P3 rejected solely for deeper location
corrections.correct: Both P1 contribution suppression and local ELF score override remain candidates. For score-only exemption, local consumer avoids changing helper semantics, but display/count/history expectations must be set and tested.
